# Clinical Management of Atypical Viral Fevers

## Assessment Overview
Viral prodromes frequently cause resting heart rate elevations of 4-10 bpm during early viremia.

## Critical Guidance
Evaluate hydration status, monitor temperature curves, and assess for respiratory or systemic warning signs.

## Escalation Criteria
Seek immediate emergency medical care if chest pain, severe breathlessness, confusion, or persistent high fever develop.
